name: Transfer funds between two shares for a member
description:
Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, look up the member by member number, and start a funds transfer. The From Share and To Share fields are dropdowns whose options are share IDs (e.g. '100987-S0001'); select exactly the given from_share and to_share values by their share ID, not by guessing a product name. Fill in the amount and memo as given. Go through the review step, confirm the details shown match what was entered, read the hidden per-transaction security token off the page, then post the transfer. This action is irreversible once posted. Read back the confirmation reference after posting.

Returns: confirmation_ref — Confirmation reference shown after posting.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, insufficient_funds, validation_rejected, share_on_hold.
